result.summary: Found 1 major layout issue where metadata text overlaps beneath a restaurant card.

issues.description: Under 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' in the 'Popular right now' section, the delivery time text ('25-35 min') and delivery fee text ('€0 delivery') overlap each other, making both unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the layout or flex/spacing properties of the metadata row so that the delivery time, delivery fee, and cuisine type are properly separated with spacing or a delimiter without overlapping.
